description: This Java source file defines the IPCHelper class, which provides utility methods for simplifying inter-process communication (IPC) calls, including sending messages and retrieving or setting various data types.

classes.name: IPCHelper
classes.description: A utility class that simplifies common IPC calls such as sending messages and retrieving or setting various data types.

methods.name: simpleSend
methods.description: Sends an IPC request with no input or output, returns true if successful.

methods.name: simpleGetInt
methods.description: Retrieves an Integer value via IPC, with optional input argument.

methods.name: simpleSetInt
methods.description: Sends an Integer value via IPC, optionally populating output.
